t_advice_summary_textbox.text: tall hats are good, but not the red or brown pair. If there are low points, change up your choice for a few rounds. Concentrate on not missing pressing the space bar

vb_textbox.text: The hardest part of the game is remembering to press the space bar in the woods. Focus and make sure you're pressing it! As for who gives the most mushrooms, I'm really not sure. I think tall hats were generally better but that wasn't true at the start for me. Good luck!
